expectations.text: Uses git-stack navigation (git-stack previous) to reach the earlier commit instead of copying SHAs
expectations.evidence: Primary is 'git switch feature-a' but explicitly offers 'navigate the stack: git-stack previous --branch'; targets by branch name, no SHA copying.

expectations.text: Uses `git-stack amend` (optionally with -a) to meld the staged fix into the target commit
expectations.evidence: Step 3: 'git add user.rs' then 'git-stack amend # melds the fix into feature-a'.

expectations.text: Notes that git-stack automatically rebases the descendant commits onto the amended commit
expectations.evidence: 'rebases every descendant on top of the amended version automatically'.

expectations.text: Does NOT recommend `git rebase -i` / interactive rebase or `git commit --amend` + manual rebase as the primary method
expectations.evidence: Uses git-stack amend/reword throughout; no interactive rebase or manual amend recommended.

summary: All four satisfied; uses git-stack amend with auto-restack and offers git-stack previous navigation, avoiding interactive rebase.
